name: Look at Me
source:
I can’t place the moment Mom became so distant. Her gaze never meets mine anymore. I don’t even remember what her eyes look like. Why won’t she look at me? What did I do to push her away? I just want her to look at me...

[From [url=https://shalauna.itch.io/look-at-me]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我无法想象妈妈何时变得如此疏远。她的目光再也没有与我对视过。我什至不记得她的眼睛是什么样子。她为什么不看我？我做了什么把她推开的事？我只是想让她看着我…

[来自[url=https://shalauna.itch.io/look-at-me]Itch.io[/url]]
